name: Neon League
note: Neon League spec (E17-L02): eight Divisions, open from the start like the House League. Its pressure is curve and precision on lanes that visibly change, with straight lines kept viable. Bosses: Slick (Oil Slick), Laser Lena (Narrow Lane) and DJ Flicker (Strobe), recurring; the champion is DJ Flicker with Strobe plus Oil Slick. Targets follow the House League's curve and are provisional until E24. Openers keep House Oil; features and bosses play the listed lane (chosen by Division number, ContentSet.assign_lanes). The rivals' first-clear items are chosen in the Neon item batches; their gates are named here and registered when E22-L02 makes the League live.

rivals.name: Slick
rivals.intro: Slick runs the oil machine and never wipes it down. Under Oil Slick every hook is halved: the same charge curves half as far, so a straight line, or a strong spin ball to win the curve back, takes this lane.

first_clear.text: A Neon item joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Mind the shine, friend. It's all slide out here.
reactions.confident: Slid right off the line. Told you.
reactions.impressed: Huh. You kept it on the board.
reactions.threatened: Wait. Who taught you to read oil?
reactions.defeated: You found the dry boards. Fine. Take the lane.
reactions.victorious: Too slick for you. Come back with a straighter arm.

rivals.name: Laser Lena
rivals.intro: Laser Lena paints the lane edges in light. Under Narrow Lane each gutter edge moves two boards in, so a wide curve drops off the lane: aim tight, roll straight, or bend it late.

first_clear.text: A Neon item joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Stay between the lines. They're closer than they look.
reactions.confident: Off the rail. The light doesn't lie.
reactions.defeated: Clean through the lasers. The light show is yours.
reactions.victorious: Lights out. Tighten your line and come back.

rivals.name: DJ Flicker
rivals.intro: DJ Flicker drops the beat on your timing. Under Strobe the ring's sweet and perfect zones are half their size, so accuracy Mult is hard to earn: build Value, strikes or power that do not need a perfect release.

first_clear.text: A Neon item joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Feel the beat? Release on the drop.
reactions.confident: Off-beat! The whole floor felt that.
reactions.defeated: Mic drop. The floor is yours.
reactions.victorious: Missed the drop. Run it back.

rivals.name: DJ Flicker, Neon Champion
rivals.intro: DJ Flicker headlines the Neon title night with Slick on the oil: the ring's sweet and perfect zones are halved and every hook is halved too, on the two-tone pattern. Its dry left half gives back some of the curve; a straight, powerful game still scores.

first_clear.text: The Neon champion's plaque goes on your shelf; the League title opens the Spectral League.

reactions.entrance: Title night. Lights low, ring fast, lane slick.
reactions.confident: The headliner doesn't miss. You did.
reactions.impressed: That one hit the drop and the pocket.
reactions.threatened: Hold up... you're stealing my set.
reactions.defeated: The encore's yours, champ. Neon bows.
reactions.victorious: Show's over. Come back when you can keep time.
